parts.text: Sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time, and each of our sites has its own charging pads. Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, while inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where they started. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and a dispatcher decides which drone flies and along which way before signing off and running the flight.
